description: Pipesim provides steady-state multiphase-flow simulation for wells and connected petroleum production networks. SLB describes three-phase flow, heat transfer and fluid-property calculations, nodal analysis and network optimisation under operating constraints. The provider is SLB. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: This is commercial software. The page does not establish the applicable licence agreement or a complete price; access terms must be confirmed with the provider. Limitations: Published capabilities are provider claims. No model was run and numerical accuracy was not independently tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports comparison of operating conditions, network capacity and proposed equipment changes. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network calculations. This is a thematic relation, not a claim of software interoperability.
